test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
Given here are four sentences. The first sentence is in correct order, while the rest of the sentences are jumbled. Pick the option that gives their correct order.

A. At last I reached my uncle’s beach house.

B. I was determined to enjoy my stay thoroughly.

C. But, somehow, I had f forgotten to pack any sunscreen.

D. So, I had packed everything I might need.
solution:
The correct answer is **"ABDC"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first sentence is correct as stated in the questions: At last, I reached my uncle's beach house.
 
• The next sentence will be **B** as it states what I was **determined** to do in that beach house:
 
 
• I was determined to **enjoy my stay thoroughly**.
 
 
 
• The next sentence will be **D **which states how I prepared for that stay:
 
 
• ​So, **I had packed everything** I might need.
 
 
 
• The next sentence will be **C** which states **he forgot something** while his preparation:
 
 
• ​But, somehow, **I had forgotten** to pack any sunscreen.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct order will be: *At last I reached my uncle’s beach house. I was determined to enjoy my stay thoroughly. So, I had packed everything I might need. But, somehow, I had f forgotten to pack any sunscreen.*

6f
